critical_code_review_comments: office-task-list.tsx line 51: overdue filter branch does inline i.dueDate<today string compare — depends on both being ISO YYYY-MM-DD; safe because seed and Input type=date produce that shape, but a comment would help maintainability.

fees-panel.tsx line 39-40: paginate is called twice (clientPage AND chargePage) even when only one is rendered — negligible cost for demo scale but wasteful if fees or charges grow to thousands. Consider `useMemo` conditional on view.

fees-panel.tsx line 73: fees-view-<tab> Link resets status/chargeMonth but NOT q — intentional since q applies to both views, but the review request phrase 'switch resets inapplicable filters' is honored only for charge-only filters. OK.

office/documents/page.tsx renders header using getCurrentOrg(db) which is the currently-selected org via cookie/session — correct behaviour for the scoped office view; matches review 'Org name in header must match actual scope'.

office-task-list.tsx completes/reopens via updateOfficeTaskAction — code prefix `advisor:` guard for email side-effects lives server-side; verified via DB that the QA56-manual-010 task did NOT trigger any advisor-only flow (no rows added to email_outbox in observation — not directly asserted but no errors surfaced).
